anchor: bottom centre of each cell (lying: the floor line; falling: the renderer puts the pickup point 6 px above the cell's bottom)

lying.note: it sits on the floor as a bag does, straps up; the beacon winks

falling.note: a courier drone twice the swarm's size brings it down, hooked into both strap loops; its rotors blur, it bobs a pixel

grip_note: per cell: where the weapon's grip point is in the cell (px, y down), for a hand-over or a catch
star: the pack's own roundel (the blue interlaced star on ivory, sewn on its side) is upright and whole in all four cells
